name: Zenryou-sei! Guren Taiiku Gakuen
original_name: 全寮制！グレン体育学園
source:
Life at a boarding sports academy is about to begin...!
When you launch this game, we’ll be holding onto your soul for three weeks at the academy.
During those three weeks, you’ll experience classes, club activities, romance, and battles...
And what mission will be assigned to you on the very last day?!
Let’s bring peace to the world while savoring the taste of youth!!
